description: Detection rules for bash tool misuse in framework code

rules.name: execSync with find
rules.message: Use Glob tool instead of execSync(find)

rules.name: execSync with grep pipe
rules.message: Use Grep tool instead of execSync with grep pipes

rules.name: execSync with cat
rules.message: Use Read tool instead of execSync(cat)

replacement.example:
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
const content = readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');

rules.name: Unescaped variable interpolation in shell
rules.message: SECURITY RISK: Unescaped variable in shell command - use input validation

rules.name: Pipe to grep with user input
rules.message: Potential injection through grep pattern - validate input first

replacement.example:
// Validate input before using in command
const safePattern = input.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

rules.name: Sequential execSync calls in loop
rules.message: Consider parallelizing or batching execSync calls

exclusions.reason: Fixed in Batch 6 Phase 1 - input validation + Glob integration
exclusions.notes: Line 78: packageName validated before interpolation (regex pattern check). Line 208: packages array is constructed from validated names only, created in phase 1 fix.

exclusions.reason: Fixed in Batch 6 Remediation Phase 1 - input validation added for all variables
exclusions.notes: All file paths and variables are validated with regex before shell interpolation. Variables are derived from safe sources (git output, path.join() results) but validation added for defense in depth.

exclusions.reason: Fixed in Batch 6 Phase 2 - migrated from execSync to execFileSync (no shell interpolation)
exclusions.notes: All execSync calls with variable interpolation replaced with execFileSync array args. No shell involved, eliminates injection surface entirely.

exclusions.reason: Loop is necessary - detecting first available package manager requires sequential probing
exclusions.notes: Cannot batch or parallelize - need to detect first available manager and return immediately. Loop exits on first match.

exclusions.reason: Fixed in Batch 6 Phase 3 - migrated from execSync to execFileSync across /skills
exclusions.notes: 31 violations fixed. All execSync calls with variable interpolation replaced with execFileSync array args. Shell cd+cmd chains replaced with cwd option. Manual quote escaping removed.

exclusions.reason: Dependency installation loops must be sequential - each install may modify system state needed by the next
exclusions.notes: Package manager installs (apt/brew) cannot be safely parallelized. Sequential execution ensures proper dependency resolution and avoids lock conflicts.

hooks.reason: Hooks must be highly efficient - critical path code

skills.reason: Skills are user-facing - security and performance critical

tools.reason: Tools support infrastructure - allow one minor issue if documented
